newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank raises bank rate at 7.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank raises bank rate at 7.5 percent.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, on Saturday said it rasied the bank rate to 7.5 percent from 7.0 percent effective on Monday.

It gave no reason for the hike, but officials with the commercial banks said the move was aimed at mobilisation of savings, restrict credit expansion and help reduce inflationery pressure on the economy.
The officials said the banks were now expected to raise minimum interest rates for deposits, which are now 6.5 percent for savings and 6.75 for fixed deposits.
